paperTitle: Virtual Acupuncture Simulator with Force Feedback and Deformable Body Models
centralContribution: This work presents a virtual acupuncture simulator that leverages a physics engine and force feedback to simulate deformable human body models, offering an immersive and realistic training experience for acupuncturists. It integrates visual and tactile representations of deformations and the activation of energy flows, based on a real-world use case, addressing previous limitations in acupuncture simulation depth and realism.

units.title: Paper Abstract
units.summary: VR and haptic devices for acupuncture training, addressing current simulator ...

content.description: The medical field increasingly uses VR and haptic devices for training. Acupuncture requires precise needle insertion into acupoints to stimulate energy flows. Existing simulators often lack comprehensive modeling of acupoints, internal systems, and accurate physiological responses, leading to a demand for advanced simulators with realistic tactile and visual feedback for practitioner training.
